*381. SHRI DWIJENDRA NA TH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the aims and objectives of the Balika
Samridhi Yojna; and
(b) the details of the amount allocated
and released to Assam under this scheme
during the last three years, year-wise and
district-wise?
Children's film festivalChildren's film festival
*382. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of cities hosting children's
film festival since 1995;
(b) whether it is a fact that Hyderabad
has become a prominent centre for hosting
the International Children's Film Festival;
(c) if so, whether Government find any
justification in establishing a children's film
festival complex at Hyderabad;
(d) if so, whether Government have
initiated any move in this direction; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

*384. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the funds received or

First generation urban reformsFirst generation urban reforms
*385. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
 Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether present Government's
approach to reform in the urban
infrastructure and services has been changed
and the emphasis would not be on
empowering the urban local bodies through
implementation of the 74th Amendment of
the Constitution instead of the earlier
method of reforms;
(b) if so, what are the main changes
Government have proposed;
(c) whether Twenty-one States and
three Union Territories have signed M.O.A.
with the Centre to undertake first generation
urban reforms;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken to implement the
same?

SHRIMATI. S.G. INDIRA:
 Will the Minister of COMMERCE

(a) whether it is a fact that India's Sea
Food exports to the U.S. are under threat;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the U.S. has imposed anti-
dumping duties on shrimp imported from
India; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?

Stand taken by India on WTO talks
1934. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India had threatened to walk
away from biased WTO Agreement as
reported in print media, if so, the details
thereof;
(b) whether it is a fact that adequate
ground work was not done for the WTO
talks;
(c) the steps taken to involve other
lesser developed countries to present a joint
stand at the WTO talks; and
(d) the details of the steps proposed by
Government to avoid taking postures which
cannot be sustained in the long run?
Export of agri products
1935. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI  AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a rise or fall
in exports of the agri products to various
world markets;
(b) the details thereof for the last
5 years, year-wise;
(c) whether Government plan to open
new markets for exports of agri products;
and
(d) the steps Government propose to
ensure the growth of agri products to
compete in the world markets?
Free movement of workers under
WTO
†1936. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether in the recent meeting of the
World Trade Organisation, while preparing
a draft of an agreement related to expansion
of future trade, the Indian delegation along-
with proposal of discussing removal of
trade bans had also placed a proposal to
consider removing ban on the movement of
the labourers;

Revised WTO agreement
1937. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the revised
"framework" agreement on global trade
finalized at the World Trade Organisation
meeting at Geneva recently;
(b) the extent to which India's interest
has been protected in agriculture and goods;
and
(c) the steps being initiated to make the
Indian agriculture globally competitive in
the final trade regime likely to emerge?
Flower exports to Asian markets
1938. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the potential of flower exports to the Asian
markets; and
(b) if so, the steps Government have
taken to facilitate flower businessmen to
export to the Asian markets?
India's share in world trade
1939. SHRI BALAWANT alias BAL
APTE:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR:
SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India's share
in the world exports which was 1.5 per
cent at Independence, has, as per the latest
records, come down to mere 0.8 per cent;
(b) if so, whether Government have
lately gone into the causes of such a drastic
decline;
(c) what are the main items the exports
whereof has largely suffered; and
(d) whether any new policy or strategy
has been worked out to restore India's due
place in the world market?
Indo-EU Free Trade Agreement
1940. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Indian Federation of
Chambers of Commerce and Industry has
suggested setting up of a joint study group
to look into the feasibility of Free Trade
Agreement between India and the European
Union;
(b) whether this move is aimed at
enhancing and deepening India's trade
relations with the EU;
(c) if so, whether any concrete
agreement in this regard has been reached;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and by when
a final decision is likely to be taken?
Trade pact with Singapore

SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:

AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Chambers of Commerce
and Industry have urged Government to
have an early trade pact with Singapore;
